subject: Re: Saturday carpool
text: Hi again, sorry for the scattered reply—I keep opening drafts and forgetting them. I meant to say the bus timing we looked at might not work after all, because the road near the stadium has a surprise closure, and I just saw it in the news. If we still go together, we could leave earlier, maybe ten before the usual time, but that depends on whether the kids are ready. I can pack snacks, though I’ll probably still be looking for one of their water bottles at the last second. Could you check if your car can fit the extra bag? If not, we might need Plan C. Anyway, let me know before bed, and I’ll sort the tickets. Sorry again, and thanks!
